model: One source failure removes all gates deriving from that source. Four primitive gates have distinct roots; each of six compound gates is assigned to one of exactly three additional independently operating roots. Weight of each gate=2/5, total budget 4.
optimality_proof: Any allocation suffers a primitive-root failure, which removes one singleton and leaves all six compounds active; resulting gap is 12/5, an upper bound. Assignment A:MI,UB; B:MU,IB; C:MB,IU attains 12/5 under all seven root failures, proving optimality within the model.
limits: Independence is stipulated, not externally verified
Exactly three independent compound roots and four primitive roots
One source root fails at a time; no simultaneous correlated failures
Equal per-gate weights 2/5, not reoptimized with root count
Graph model, not physical QCD or elemental physics
